external_collaboration.evidence_quote: “Soles4Souls is a key part of Crocs’ circularity and social impact journey, and specifically the success of our consumer takeback program. Our takeback bins continue to fill up with shoes ready for a new life, not only from consumers in our retail stores, but also from our corporate employees in our offices. Crocs, Inc. employees are proud of our longstanding partnership with Soles4Souls and the positive impact on climate and community that we’ve achieved together.”

“Trove and Soles4Souls share a similar mission: getting every item to its next best use. By integrating Soles4Souls into our recommerce ecosystem, we’ve created a seamless way for brands to eliminate waste and extend the lifecycle of their products, all while helping uplift communities around the globe. It’s a partnership built on shared values and measurable impact.”

“Partnering with Soles4Souls has allowed EILEEN FISHER Renew to not only extend the lifecycle of our clothing, but also create opportunities for people to build a better future through the Soles4Souls 4Opportunity program.”

network.coverage_note: Soles4Souls is a non-profit organization rather than an educational institution, so it does not have traditional campuses or Erasmus+ mobility programs. The evidence provides a list of corporate partners but does not contain a comprehensive list of all institutional partners.
